InstituteProfile.Name: Avijan
InstituteProfile.Tagline: An Unit of Computer Professionals & Learners
InstituteProfile.Introduction: Avijan is an ISO 9001: 2015 certified institution is the brainchild of a group of professionals. We have started this computer center in the year 2008 keeping in mind to increase computer education soon within the common man's reach. Gradually Avijan started Multi-Functional Computer Training Courses. Our vision is to create a world class quality institute for training young minds for the IT related profession. This has to be done by keeping costs affordable and infrastructure both physical and academic most up-to-date and accessible.
Highlights: ISO 9001:2015 certified, teaching computer skills since 2008
Multi-functional computer training courses from beginner to specialisation
ISO certificate issued on successful completion of every course
Affordable fees with a transparent ledger and printable receipts
